recognize_zh: 胸水抹片中只見一小群大型細胞，胞質豐富淡藍有空泡、邊緣呈毛邊狀，核圓形置中並有小核仁，其間夾有中性球；這些較像反應性間皮細胞或巨噬細胞，此視野看不到神經母細胞瘤的小圓細胞團，與標題僅部分相符。
features: Small group of large cells with abundant pale blue, finely vacuolated cytoplasm and fringed (ruffled) borders
Central round nuclei with fine chromatin and small nucleoli; one binucleate-appearing cell
Adjacent smaller cell with a round nucleus and an intervening neutrophil
Separate vacuolated macrophage-like cells with folded nuclei
Very sparse cellularity; no cohesive clusters of small round tumor cells in this field
describe_en: Cytospin preparation of pleural fluid shows low cellularity, with a small group of large cells having abundant vacuolated cytoplasm with ruffled borders and round central nuclei with small nucleoli, accompanied by vacuolated macrophages, a neutrophil and scattered red cells. The morphology in this field favors reactive mesothelial cells and histiocytes. No cohesive clusters of small round cells characteristic of metastatic neuroblastoma are present in this field; the image therefore only partially supports the stated diagnosis, and review of additional fields and immunocytochemistry would be required.

ddx.vs: Favored here: large cells with central nuclei, dense-to-vacuolated cytoplasm with microvillous borders, calretinin/WT1 positive.
Would appear as small round cells with high N:C ratio and nuclear molding in cohesive clusters, PHOX2B/synaptophysin positive.
Forms three-dimensional clusters with large nucleoli and nuclear pleomorphism, positive for epithelial markers such as MOC-31/BerEP4.
